description: Creates branded Open Graph image designs for a site with AI and returns a link where the person picks one, tweaks it and publishes. Needs a getwowlink account (the client asks the person to sign in). The result includes the picker link; nothing is published until the person presses Publish there, never by this tool. While the site is still being read, the result says so and a later call continues.

page_type.description: What the designs are for: landing (the site or a marketing page), product (a product page) or article (a post). Detected when omitted.

site_url.description: The site, or the page the designs are for (a product, a post), e.g. example.com or example.com/products/mug

name: create_previews
title: Design OG images for a site
